description: Check an OpenAPI document for the defects that make an agent-generated client fail: missing operationIds, absent error responses and non-HTTPS servers. Before publishing an OpenAPI document that agents will generate clients from. Do not choose this when you need the API called, which needs the service running. Example requests: Check my OpenAPI document for defects that break generated clients. | Are my operationIds and error responses complete? | Audit this OpenAPI spec for agent client compatibility. | Find the problems in this API spec before I publish it.

accepted_price.description: The quoted amount, echoed exactly; checked against the quote.

authorized_by.description: Identifier of the human or agent authorizing this job.

buyer_token.description: The buyer_token returned with your first purchase. It opens the purchase history for that buyer, including earlier deliverables.

idempotency_key.description: Retry key; the same key returns the same job.

openapi.description: The customer's openapi.json, as text. Supported: JSON. The OpenAPI document. Maximum 1048576 bytes.

payment_signature.description: x402 payment payload; required for a priced capability (see submit_job).

quote_id.description: The quote_id from POST /v1/jobs; required when priced.

name: submit_openapi_conformance_check
title: OpenAPI conformance check
